blocking_methods.label: digisaathi
blocking_methods.instructions: DigiSaathi (NPCI 24x7 digital-payments helpline): 1800-891-3333. Provides guidance on blocking RuPay cards and routes you to your issuing bank — RuPay hotlisting itself is done by the issuing bank.
